input: Laminate and frame the kids' crayon drawings

gold.taskTitle: Laminate and Frame the Kids' Crayon Drawings
gold.taskDescription: Preserve and display the children's crayon drawings by laminating and framing them.

questions.title: How many drawings do you want to laminate and frame?
questions.description: Determine the total count of drawings to be processed.

questions.title: What size are the drawings, roughly?
questions.description: Understand the dimensions to choose the right lamination pouches and frames.

questions.title: Will you laminate at home or use a print shop?
questions.description: Clarify whether lamination will be DIY or outsourced to a service.

questions.title: Do you already own a laminator and frames?
questions.description: Check what supplies are on hand versus what needs to be purchased.

questions.title: Where will the framed drawings be displayed?
questions.description: Identify the display location to guide frame style and mounting method.

questions.title: Do you have a preference for frame style or color?
questions.description: Understand any aesthetic preferences to narrow down frame choices.

questions.title: When do you want this fully completed by?
questions.description: Establish a deadline or target date to structure the task timeline.
